title: Edit NPC fields
description: Renaming the greeter, toggling its glow and moving it

console: animus create greeter name=greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.result: Edit greeter lists Identity, Body, Position, Appearance, Movement, Attributes
Identity of greeter lists id, name, type, owner, tags, behaviors and groups
The nameplate reads Town Greeter; chat: Set name to Town Greeter on greeter
Body of greeter lists pose, baby, glowing, gravity and the other body flags
Chat: Set glowing to true on greeter
Town Greeter now has a white glow outline
Edit greeter opens again on the same sections
Body of greeter again, with glowing now on
Chat: Set glowing to false on greeter
Town Greeter stands where you stood; chat: Moved greeter here

closing: The greeter is now Town Greeter and stands where you stood
